interface.shortDescription: A visual DSH home for DeepSeek, ChatGPT, or both.
interface.longDescription: Guides installation and operation of DSH Vibeify in DeepSeek-only, ChatGPT-only, or combined Codex-led modes. The Web UI becomes a content-first visual experience; governed mode adds Codex capability presets, visible progress, queue/steer controls, and bounded DeepSeek execution while connected apps retain protected approvals.
